CheckTitle: Check if SageMaker Studio domain uses IAM authentication
Description: Check if SageMaker Studio domain uses IAM authentication instead of SSO for fine-grained access control.
Risk: SSO authentication may provide less granular access control compared to IAM, potentially allowing broader access than intended.

Recommendation.Text: Consider using IAM authentication for SageMaker Studio domain to leverage fine-grained IAM policies for access control.
